## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.9

v1.2.9 introduces the Rune Enhancement & Stat Framework and completes the first runtime-validated GUI pass for purchase, enhancement, awakening ranks, and awakening availability.

### Added
- Added permanent enhancement levels for all 26 fixed rune slots. Enhancement belongs to the slot and remains stored even while the slot is empty.
- Added independent enhancement batches `x1`, `x5`, `x10`, and `x100`; every attempt independently selects one of the 26 fixed slots and repeated hits are allowed.
- Added the rune stat framework used by the Poison catalog and final-value tooltip rendering.
- Added client synchronization for enhancement levels and server-authored rune economy metadata.
- Added regression coverage for the fixed Poison catalog, enhancement packets, rune economy configuration, and multi-status economy routing.

### Changed
- Rune power now uses the enhancement multiplier `1 + level × enhancement_step`; the current default enhancement step is `0.1`.
- Poison enhancement currently uses Rune Dust with a technical default cost of `10` per successful enhancement attempt.
- Purchase/duplicate feedback uses a short blue pulse, while enhancement feedback uses a green pulse.
- Improved runes now use a persistent light silver border and Advanced runes use a persistent light gold border.
- Awakening availability is shown separately as a blinking marker on the left side of the rune: silver for Ordinary → Improved and gold for Improved → Advanced.
- The awakening marker is only shown when progression requirements are satisfied and the player can afford the configured awakening cost.
- The legacy small top-left rank corner marker is no longer part of the active rank presentation.

### Fixed
- Fixed visual overlap between rank presentation, purchase feedback, enhancement feedback, hover state, and awakening availability.
- Fixed awakening availability feedback so insufficient resources no longer leave a misleading actionable marker visible.

### Other
- Enhancement is a separate system from awakening: awakening changes rank, while enhancement increases the permanent level of a fixed rune slot.
- Enhancement currently has no gameplay-defined maximum level; normal integer implementation limits still apply.
- Rank multipliers and current economy values remain part of the v1.2.9 framework and are not the final long-term balance.
- Runtime validation passed for purchase, enhancement, rank borders, awakening markers, resource gating, and hover/pulse interactions.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated mod version metadata to `1.2.9`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.9.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.8...v1.2.9](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.8...v1.2.9)
